$schema: PUB-M9: a coverage ratchet. Each package's line/branch percentage must never fall below the value recorded here (a small tolerance absorbs floating-point rounding). Raise a value only when coverage has genuinely improved and stays there -- never lower one to make a regression pass. PUB-H5 rescoped measurement to each package's own src/ tree (--test-coverage-include=src/**/*.js, see check-coverage.mjs), which raised every floor below: the prior numbers included whatever workspace-sibling or v2/template/theme-default sibling-repository code a package's tests happened to load, not just its own source.
